front_content.text:
原句：只有当关键核心技术实现自主可控，中国相关产业才能在全球竞争中掌握主动。

任务：先汉译英，再选出倒装和搭配都正确的一项。

back_content.text: Only when key core technologies become self-reliant and controllable can related industries in China take the initiative in global competition.
back_content.explanation: Only when 前置后触发 can 倒装；take the initiative in... 是固定搭配。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文“只有当……才能……”给出时间条件与结果的强绑定关系，适合用 Only when 条件从句前置。

② 核心规律：Only when/only if 前置时，倒装发生在主句而不是从句。也就是说，从句维持正常语序，主句写 can + 主语 + 动词原形。

③ 验证：A 中 Only when 从句正常，主句 can related industries in China take... 倒装正确。B 未倒装；C 倒装位置错到从句；D 用 taking 破坏了情态结构。
tips: 检查 only 从句句型时，先找主句，再看主句是否倒装。
take the initiative in global competition 是高频政策语体搭配。

options.text: Only when key core technologies become self-reliant and controllable can related industries in China take the initiative in global competition.
Only when key core technologies become self-reliant and controllable related industries in China can take the initiative in global competition.
Only when do key core technologies become self-reliant and controllable can related industries in China take the initiative in global competition.
Only when key core technologies become self-reliant and controllable can related industries in China taking the initiative in global competition.

front_content.text:
原句：在任何时候，我们都不能忽视基础研究对原始创新的支撑作用。

先汉译英，再补全倒装表达：
At no time {{blank}} we ignore the supporting role of basic research in original innovation.

back_content.text: At no time should we ignore the supporting role of basic research in original innovation.
back_content.explanation: At no time 为否定副词短语前置，主句需倒装：should we ignore...。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：否定意义短语 At no time 放句首时，英文语法要求主句倒装。

② 核心规律：否定副词或否定副词短语前置（never, seldom, at no time, by no means）常触发部分倒装，结构为 助动词/情态 + 主语 + 动词原形。

③ 验证：空格填 should 最自然，既表达规范语体中的“不可忽视”，又满足倒装要求。填 do/can 虽有语义可能，但在该政策语体中 should 更稳。
tips: 看到句首否定词先反射性检查倒装。
政策与论证句里 should 常用于表达原则性要求。

front_content.text:
原句：只有持续提高基础研究质量，科技创新体系才能形成长期竞争优势。

任务：先汉译英，再核对 only 前置后的倒装是否完整。

back_content.text: Only by continuously improving the quality of basic research can the scientific innovation system build long-term competitive advantages.
back_content.explanation: Only by 前置需主句 can 倒装。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文“只有……才能……”是限制条件句。

② 核心规律：Only by + doing 句首时，主句用 can + 主语 + 动词原形。

③ 验证与纠偏：译文已满足倒装要求并完整表达结果。
tips: Only by 句首结构优先排查倒装。
竞争优势常写为 competitive advantages。

front_content.text:
原句：直到数据治理框架全面落地，金融风险监测体系才真正实现协同运转。

任务：先汉译英，再选出倒装最规范的一项。

back_content.text: Not until the data governance framework was fully implemented did the financial risk monitoring system truly achieve coordinated operation.
back_content.explanation: Not until 前置后主句采用 did 倒装。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：“直到……才……”对应 Not until 结构。

② 核心规律：过去事实叙述常用 did 倒装，后接动词原形。

③ 验证与纠偏：A 结构完整；其他项常见缺倒装或动词形态错误。
tips: Not until 前置后，主句很少保持原序。
did 后谓语必须原形。

options.text: Not until the data governance framework was fully implemented did the financial risk monitoring system truly achieve coordinated operation.
Not until the data governance framework was fully implemented the financial risk monitoring system truly achieved coordinated operation.
Not until the data governance framework was fully implemented did the financial risk monitoring system truly achieved coordinated operation.
Not until the data governance framework is fully implemented did the financial risk monitoring system truly achieve coordinated operation.

front_content.text:
原句：只有在高水平开放合作中，产业链现代化水平才能持续提升。

先做汉译英，再补全骨架：
Only in high-level open cooperation {{blank}} the modernization level of industrial chains {{blank}} continuously improved.

back_content.text: Only in high-level open cooperation can the modernization level of industrial chains be continuously improved.
back_content.explanation: Only in 前置后主句需倒装，并可与被动结构叠加。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：句子为 only 前置限制结构。

② 核心规律：主句倒装可与被动语态并行，常见形式 can + 主语 + be + done。

③ 验证与纠偏：两空填 can 和 be 后，结构完整且意义准确。
tips: 倒装与被动并用时，先锁助动词位置。
modernization level 对应“现代化水平”。

front_content.text:
原句：在任何时候，监管规则都不能脱离实体经济运行实际。

任务：先汉译英，再选出否定前置倒装正确的一项。

back_content.text: At no time should regulatory rules be detached from the realities of the real economy.
back_content.explanation: At no time 前置触发 should 倒装。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：句首否定短语 At no time。

② 核心规律：否定前置时主句需倒装；被动语态用于“规则被脱离”语义。

③ 验证与纠偏：A 在倒装和被动上均正确。
tips: At no time 后常接 should/do/did 倒装。
be detached from 是稳定搭配。

At no time regulatory rules should be detached from the realities of the real economy.
At no time should regulatory rules detached from the realities of the real economy.
